summary: Transform messy homes into cozy, beautifully organized spaces. Clean up, arrange every room, and place objects wherever you want—there are no wrong choices. Relax, get creative, and make every home feel just right.

title: Sandweh
summary: Sandweh is a cozy sand-surfing journey about carving trails, catching air, and drifting through quiet desert worlds shaped by wind and sand.

title: Just Fly
summary: Just Fly is a cozy-adrenaline wingsuit flying game with no forced goals. Explore procedural sky islands filled with canyons, tunnels, and dangerous cave systems. Master proximity flying, dodge wind turbine blades, and enjoy relaxed flight with ragdoll crashes and instant respawns.

title: Super-Type
summary: Super-Type is a brutal keyboard-driven arcade score attack game. Use the entire range of keys to target multiple threats at once, and try to survive an invasion escalating faster than you can control.

title: Echoes of Another Sky
summary: Echoes of Another Sky is a fantasy action role-playing game about a boy and a talking bell exploring thirteen skies. Combat combines action combos with tuning-fork magic.

title: Tin Coffins

title: Noël Macabre
summary: Noël macabre is a narrative-driven horror FPS that blends dark comedy with cosmic horror. Play as Georges, a police officer forced to return to work on Christmas Eve. Investigate a mysterious threat and save those who can still be saved. Will you see your duty through to the end?

title: Ink and Lore
summary: A 99-floor roguelike of cards that vanish the moment they're played. Lead two guardians of living stationery into a picture book someone stopped drawing. Your cards are finite—choosing when to spend them is life or death. And at the end of the world waits the one who—

title: GigaStriker
summary: GIGASTRIKER is a 3D football survivors-like where every goal sends enemies flying. Your striker kicks automatically as you dodge swarms, slide-tackle through crowds and stack upgrades into devastating builds. Recruit teammates, take down bosses and unlock new strikers for your next run.

title: Hacker: The Dark Shadow
summary: Become a young programmer diving into the dangerous world of cybercrime. When the elite hacking collective Dark Shadows challenges you with a series of ruthless trials, you must push your genius to the limit. Will you prove your worth or become another digital casualty?

similarGames.name: The Pirate Queen: With Lucy Liu

title: The First Pixel
summary: In the beginning there is a white screen and one black pixel. Click it, and it wakes. Grow it into pattern, memory and meaning, hunt 100 lost relics across erased worlds, and discover what a pixel sees once it has gathered everything. A quiet, mysterious incremental.

title: Senti Metrica
summary: “If you are not loved, you won’t survive—” A girl slowly turning into a monster, and the “Metrica” who hunt her. A survival otome game where you waver between reason and instinct.

title: Room Movers
summary: Room Movers is a cozy two-player online co-op game about unboxing and arranging tiny diorama workplaces such as a café, a flower shop and a dentist's office. Small boxes can be opened alone, while big boxes and heavy furniture need both players to grab an end and pull together. There is no grid and nothing snaps into place: every item is moved by hand with physics. There is no score, no timer and no fail state. When both players press Done, the camera circles the finished room and hands them a polaroid that is added to an album on the menu wall and can be saved to the desktop.

title: Bloom & Dine
summary: Bloom & Dine is a cozy chaos cooking game on a match-3 board. Match ingredients to fire up the stoves, fit each dish onto the board and serve it before your guest's patience runs out. Work your way through a few kitchens over 99 in-game days, from a tiny pizzeria to a grill terrace by the sea, with bonus puzzle days and hidden object levels along the way.

title: Glaring Flaw
summary: Glaring Flaw is a narrative puzzle adventure built around shifting perspectives. Unlock new camera angles, discover hidden paths and clues, and explore a rural family estate threatened by both a natural disaster and the dawn of a new era.

similarGames.name: A Completely Fictional Story About a City Inside a Whale

title: My Snake Likes Apples
summary: A short, minimalist incremental game about raising a foolish snake and helping it go the distance. The snake moves on its own to reach apples. Players collect apple seeds to upgrade its speed, bite strength, and intelligence, helping it progress through harsher places.

title: Neon & Bones
summary: Neon & Bones is a management game set in Las Vegas in 1957. The player runs a casino for the Chicago mob and each night splits the take between taxes, the Family, the crew and their own pocket; skimming too little angers the Family, skimming too much draws the FBI. The game features a seven-chapter story campaign (1957-1961), casino floor building, property and casino acquisitions on the Strip, a 30-day Season mode and three multiplayer modes (Quick War, Shared House, Shared Strip). Available in English and Czech.

title: Carrot Count Sheep
summary: Play as Carrot, a little bug who dives into sheep's dreams, solves puzzles, and wakes them up to join their adventure. But when Carrot wakes up, their journey is just beginning... Whose dream is this, anyway?

title: Abandoned Below
summary: Abandoned Below is a first-person cooperative zombie survival game set in an abandoned underground bunker. Play alone or with friends, fight increasingly dangerous waves of zombies, rebuild barricades, and unlock new areas as you explore the complex.

title: Minato Shokudo: Mirage of the Great Clam
summary: A cozy Japanese cooking game where you play a ghost with a diner to run and no sense of taste. So you cook everything by the book. Then you row the food across the harbor while it's hot. All 50 dishes come with a real recipe to try at home. One foggy night, the lighthouse goes dark.

title: Stay On the White Lines
summary: One day after school, a boy walks home along a white line. His curfew is 5:00 p.m. The white line is filled with treasures that spark his imagination, turning the walk home into an adventure. Become that boy and journey through Hakusen, the childhood sanctuary where imagination comes to life.

title: AI Empire Tycoon
summary: Build your own AI empire in a world of business, competition, and innovation! Grow your company, cooperate with other players, sabotage your rivals, and compete for dominance. Will you rise together or crush the competition?

title: Finish Your Meatballs!
summary: Finish Your Meatballs! is a galactic double stick shooter inspired by old classic arcade games. Defeat multiple enemies and surpass your friends and THE WORLD with your best scores in various game modes!

title: Rage Trip
summary:
Rage Trip is a 2D pixel art precision platformer featuring six levels filled with spikes, saws, flames, and moving platforms. Players navigate obstacles, collect cherries, and reach the finish while prerecorded voice taunts react to their failures and level completions.

The game includes a solo campaign and two multiplayer modes for 2–4 players. In Friend Race, players compete to finish first, with individual deaths and respawns. In Shared Fate, one teammate’s death sends the entire team back to the start of the level. Players also collide with one another, adding another challenge to coordinating their jumps.

title: Heal Me Faster
summary: You're the healer in a pixel-art incremental RPG where your company fights and your healing choices matter. Manage mana, shield a marked ally and recruit from twenty-one classes. Between battles, grow a working camp, shop and town. They charge. You keep them standing.

title: Economics Rulez
summary: Economics simulator with a world living on its own.

title: From Cave to Shelf
summary: Dig into the earth, explore mysterious caves, and collect crystals. Arrange your finds on the shelves of an abandoned magical mineral museum, upgrade your skills, and turn chaos into perfect order.

title: Hanafuda Solitaire
summary: Hanafuda Solitaire is a single-player card game that turns Hanafuda, the traditional Japanese flower cards, into a solitaire game. All 48 cards are dealt face up into 6 columns of 8. The player captures pairs of cards from the same month and forms classic Hanafuda yaku, such as Boar-Deer-Butterfly and Three Brights, to score points. Every deal is verified to be winnable, and each deal has a numbered seed that can be shared to play the same deal. The rules can also be played with a physical Hanafuda deck.

title: Sort of the Apocalypse
summary: The world ended. The mess didn’t. Sort over 10,000 scavenged supplies in a cozy first-person organizing game. Transform a cluttered bunker into satisfyingly stocked shelves, earn credits, and unlock upgrades to tackle the mountain of mess.

title: Dull Ache
summary: Dull Ache is a top-down, dungeon crawler, JRPG inspired psychological horror game about survival, identity, faith, self-destruction, and the frightening parts of yourself you would rather leave buried.

title: Rank Risk: Guess the Order
summary: Rank Risk: Guess the Order is a single-player trivia puzzle game. Each round deals six answer cards that must be placed in the correct order, such as animals by top speed, peppers by Scoville heat or planets by size. Before each question the player chooses how many Rank Points to risk. A wrong submission costs an attempt and only reveals how many cards are in the correct position. The game has 120 puzzles across 12 categories, eight power-ups, eight ranks, Steam achievements and leaderboards.

title: Last Spin: Survive
summary: Your next spin could keep you alive. A dark first-person roguelite in a sealed bunker: collect artifacts, push payouts to the limit, and unlock permanent upgrades. Survive 12 days and hold out for evacuation.

title: Sus Squad
summary: Sus Squad is a multiplayer social deduction party game. Gather your squad, finish tasks across haunted maps and find out who is lying before it's too late. Call meetings, vote suspects out and play special roles like Sheriff, Medic or Jester. Includes a Hot Potato party mode.

title: Fullbokko Kindergarten: Classic Remaster
summary: Spend a cute—and slightly violent—day at kindergarten with Kotomi, your one and only friend. The free visual novel Fullbokko Kindergarten returns as a Classic Remaster, preserving the artwork and atmosphere of the original release.

title: IAFT Fear Diagnosis
summary: A new kind of horror game that builds a stage just for you from the results of a fear diagnosis. Scary, and a little funny. Heights, tight spaces, bugs, ghosts, even paperwork: your fears combine into over 2 million stages, so no two runs are alike. Too scary? Exclude any fear in the settings.

title: Catharsis: The Last of Atelier
summary: Knowing nothing of who you are, you step into the worlds of iconic masterpieces. Walk through paintings, gather “memories,” and fill your empty vessel in this immersive art adventure. At the end of a journey through beautiful memories, what “world” will you paint?

title: Starwake: Echoes of Time
summary: STARWAKE: Echoes of Time is an HD pixel-art action roguelike for Windows PC with a full anime story. Fight in real time as one of four heroes, take the powers of twenty gods across 331 boon cards, cross six worlds and a final dimension, and come home to Starfall Town between nights, a little stronger every time.

title: High Tide
summary: A story-driven adventure where Doug accidentally unleashes an ancient curse across a tropical island. Explore, solve environmental puzzles, battle corrupted creatures, help strange locals, and uncover how to bring the missing people back.

title: EchoMon: Pack & Stack
summary: Transform a chaotic store into a pristine collector's haven. EchoMon is a cozy first-person shop simulator where you organize an incredible 3,600 elemental trading cards. Upgrade your skills, unleash magical sorting abilities, and experience the pure satisfaction of a perfect shelf.

title: The Artisan of Glimmith: Lunar Lights
summary: Illuminate your mind in Lunar Lights, the dazzling new expansion for The Artisan of Glimmith. Celebrate the vibrant "Glass Lights Festival" as you master 12+ new puzzle rules designed to surprise and delight artisans of all experience levels. Step into the glow and unravel the festival's mysteries.

title: Sorted by Christmas
summary: It’s almost Christmas and there’s a mountain of 100,000 presents still to sort. Round up your Gonk Squad for first-person co-op chaos with vacuums, black holes and Festive Dynamite. Up to 8 players, or solo.

title: Kitten Wool Cup
summary: Kitten Wool Cup is a cozy, silly multiplayer game where kittens play football with a giant ball of wool. Short, chaotic matches against bots or online with up to 4 players (2 v 2) are full of pounces, pile-ups and zoomies, with a roomba crossing the pitch and a surprise cucumber that makes everyone leap. Between matches, players earn wool to dress their kitten in hats, collars and a Santa beard, decorate a snug room by the fire with furniture and Christmas decorations, and invite friends round before heading into a match together.

title: Sanatorium of Evil
summary: The monsters just wanted a quiet soak. Then heroes barged in with their "Purification". A pixel-art bullet heaven: draw trail signs with your steps, evolve weapons and hold out until 21:00. Then write the intruders a referral: Straight to Traumatology!

title: SuperReap
summary: Super Reap is a cozy active incremental harvesting game where you swing your scythe through wildly overgrown crops, sell resources for coins, unlock talents, skill cards, gear, and new harvesting methods, and transform a rundown farm into an efficient reaping paradise.

title: The Gloaming Hand
summary: A free online card battler where the sky decides the fight. Plant units at Dawn, let them ripen through the Day, strike before Dusk and bluff through the Night. Five lanes, four phases, one sundial: every card is worth something different at every hour.

similarGames.name: A Game of Thrones: The Board Game - Digital Edition

title: Conflicto Armado
summary: Conflicto Armado is a turn-based tactics and stealth game set during Colombia's armed conflict, from 1985 to 2016, told from the middle ground: soldiers, farmers, victims and people who just want to get out alive. Lead Corporal Wilson's squad tile by tile through jungle, river, paramo and city across 38 missions in four acts: escort a boat full of medicine, find a car bomb in twelve turns, protect a witness in Medellin, slip alone into a camp to rescue hostages. Choices change the ending. Includes online co-op for Act I and a free 3-mission prologue.

title: Night Machine
summary: We’ve just learned the Moon is a giant alien doomsday factory, which is kind of a bummer. You've been chosen to operate a spaceship into the core and destroy it for us. Think fast, adapt under pressure, and deploy powerful combinations as you fight your way through in this real-time card battler.

title: Sheeple
summary: Cast cards to turn the tides of the battlefield, gather your army, and fight to regain The Original Sheep! Sheeple is a grand real time Auto battler with roguelike and deck-building elements.

title: Manifesto
summary:
Manifesto is a new management sim about burnout, layoffs, and making shitloads of money.

You’ve climbed the ranks, left countless competitors in your wake, and proven you have what it takes to survive in this cut-throat business. With this latest venture, you’ll have to put any human feelings you’ve ever experienced aside, and attempt to satisfy shareholders who can never truly be satisfied.

title: Soulcery: Deck of Shadows
summary: An action roguelike fused with deck-building combat. Steal enemy abilities to shape your battle deck and unleash relentless, zero-cooldown combos.

title: Deeper Still
summary: A really hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die. Find a better plan. Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them.

title: Cielle Is Not Happy
summary: Cielle is Not Happy is a psychological horror RPG in which you play as a girl named Cielle, who encounters erratic events throughout her journey, leading her to uncover cryptic secrets about herself and the world around her.

title: System 21
summary: Manipulate a blackjack game from the inside as a dealer subroutine in this minimalist roguelike deckbuilder. Read the visible card's queue, execute illegal code exploits to alter the upcoming cards, and fleece high-rolling patrons before the system anti-cheat detects your anomaly.

title: Tidy Wizard: A Place For Every Plate
summary: Clean up wizard dining halls with magic! A satisfying organizing simulator where you levitate scattered dishes, wash tableware in enchanted basins, and return each piece to its proper cabinet. Unlock new spells to help transmute bigger & bigger messes into shiny, neat spaces!

title: Tidy up the Backrooms
summary: A store's items have gone missing in the Backrooms, and it's your job to bring it back. Explore the endless yellow halls using your tech and tools, restock the store and solve the mystery of what really happened to the store. Don't like scares? Turn the horror off and enjoy a cozy tidy!

title: Quiet Bloom
summary: Quiet Bloom is a cozy idle game. Awaken the wind, dig wells, and call the rain to tend your land for you. Gather wood, stone, and water, raise wind vanes and solar panels, and watch a cracked desert slowly bloom into a luxuriant green oasis.

title: Fieldmade
summary: Everything in this world is something you drew. Sketch a hoe and till the soil with it. Sketch an axe, a watering can, a fishing rod... and they become real, working tools with real stats. You can draw literally anything you want.

title: The Veil Express
summary: The Veil Express is a cozy city-building and resource-management game in which players build and manage a fairytale train carrying a crew of witches, goblins, fairies, ghosts and vampires.

title: Sam, We Talked About This
summary: Sam, We Talked About This is an idle incremental game. Scrape whatever the internet has, train AI models on it, let the models pull in subscribers and turn them into cash. Put the cash into more disks, bigger machines and a bigger crew. The loop feeds itself and speeds up, and the models keep getting smarter. AGI is waiting at the end.

title: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 3.4 - The Finality of the Day
summary: The story of the Sky Island of Roscaelifer reaches its final climax, as Sunbringer, a new Void Hunter and the first Enchainer Agent, joins the fight. The new version also kicks off the Zenless Zone Zero × Honkai: Star Rail collaboration, introducing two crossover Agents, Robin and Kafka, along with themed events. It also brings new combat gameplay, updates to permanent game modes, and a variety of version rewards.

title: Outlier
summary: Crews sent into the Backrooms have begun reporting strange symptoms. You're one of them. Outlier is an online hide-and-seek game for up to 16 players: blend into a crowd of identical hazmat suits, secretly let out the unbearable urge, and don't let the Overseer notice. Can you act normal to the end?

title: Eight Legs, Seven Nights
summary: Eight Legs, Seven Nights is a first-person cozy horror game. You look after your aunt Margit's thirteen spiders in her snowed-in house during the week before Christmas. Days are cozy chores: feeding, misting, mopping, cleaning the tanks, the radio and an evening film. Nights grow stranger, with nightmares and something large moving in the house. The game has five endings, a diary to find and a hidden arcade game. Jump scares can be turned off, and an arachnophobia warning is shown at launch.

title: Too Fun
summary: Too Fun is a first-person party game for 2–8 players, set in a late-night TV game show. Each match is a run of episodes drawn at random from the game pool: some test skill (running, jumping, dodging), others bluffing and persuasion. Proximity voice chat is always on, so what you say, and when you stay silent, is part of the game. The player with the most points at the end of the match wins.

title: Buy the Dip, Milady
summary: Buy the Dip, Milady is a 1v1 auto-battle strategy game. Players mine silver with a pickaxe, spend it on contracts that summon maids who fight automatically, and buy or short-sell stocks whose prices react to the battle in real time. The goal is to destroy the rival noble's castle. Modes include a story campaign, an endless tower, quick battles and ranked online PvP on Steam, along with minigames such as a survivor-style mode and a merge puzzle. New maids are obtained with in-game currency only; there are no paid pulls.

title: Ski Lines: Trail Map
summary: Ski Lines: Trail Map is a minimalist strategy game in which players design a ski resort by drawing runs and placing lifts directly on a trail map. Skiers choose their routes based on their skill level and the connections available. As new destinations appear and queues build up, players use limited resources to adapt the network and help skiers get back to the base station before the resort closes at 6 p.m.

title: Pistara
summary: There's been a murder and no one left the house. Place every suspect on the floor plan using the clues and the rules, and the culprit is revealed: whoever was alone with the victim. A deduction game where you don't guess who did it; you work out where everyone was. 100 cases, each with exactly one solution, from 4 × 4 houses with three suspects to 8 × 8 houses with seven, plus a detective career under Inspector Bellini and hints that teach the next deduction.

title: Fall Up
summary: Take a leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with our adorable Labi! You need to traverse this cartoonish world with a variety of jumps and moves, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots and reveal the secrets of this world.

title: Aeterna Lucis
summary: Aeterna Lucis is the highly anticipated sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Following the gameplay steps of the first entry in the series, Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania that combines fast-paced combat, a large interconnected map, secret hunting, optional challenges, and a rich and deep story.

summary: Waltz is a pure and innocent soul who awoke in Downtown, and Jam is the lovable dog who was there waiting. Join them on this amazing and heartwarming journey.

summary: Captain a giant drill-city in this roguelite citybuilder. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your mettle and paw-some cat crew.

title: Edge of Memories
summary: The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples—so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination—now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

summary: Fight your way through a diverse world in this action-adventure side scroller, where you are given one weapon and die in one hit. Can you earn the right to peer beyond the Zeroed Abyss?

title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
summary: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

title: Freestyle Football 2
summary: Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game. Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team. Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

title: While 1:
summary: Don't touch the walls. While 1 is a minimalist mouse-only action game centered around this simple concept. Create a loop around the level while avoiding obstacles synchronized to the music.

title: Bloomies
summary:
Bloomies are cute little creatures born from seeds and eggs, growing while you go about your day on your PC. But peace doesn’t last forever because Shadow Bloomies are waiting for the right moment to invade and take over your taskbar world.
In Bloomies, you plant seeds, grow eggs, and hatch over a hundred unique Bloomies, each with different ranks. Raise them, collect rare Sparkle Bloomies, and watch your tiny companions live their lives.
When Shadow Bloomies attack, your Bloomies automatically jump into battle. Defeat powerful bosses in order to unlock new seeds and items.
Prefer a calmer experience? Cozy Mode lets you disable combat entirely and simply enjoy collecting, decorating, and customizing your Bloomies at your own pace. You can even automate your experience through the skill system.
Bloomies is a cozy monster-collector with light farming and idle elements that runs directly on your taskbar . But it doesn’t have to stay there. Resize it, move it anywhere on your desktop, and create multiple profiles to match your mood. Decorate your world with tons of items, dress your Bloomies with adorable hats, or even turn Bloomies themselves into hats.

title: Vanguard Valiants
summary: Reclaim the lands taken by the Zahar. Build and lead armies to recover the villages seized by the enemy. Acquire better weapons and manage your soldiers throughout the liberation campaign.

title: Step Theater
summary: Welcome to the "step theater". "Step theater" is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!

title: Hammer & Harvest: Dwarven Roots
summary: A dwarf farm sim! The days of dragons'-fire have ended, and now the Dwarf King has commissioned you to reclaim the ancient halls. Grow crops, harvest crystals, mine ores, and craft works of awe & wonder. Enrich your home beneath the mountains before the Dwarf King returns to judge your progress...

title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the Dragon Quest series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

title: Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition
summary:
When the Glade of Dreams is overrun by “nefurrious” Darktoons, the Fairy Council summons Rayman to save the day. Joined by his best friend, Globox, and two crafty wizards, the Teensies, this unlikely team must restore balance before their world fades away like a bad dream.

summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

summary: Its your grandmas 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and dont worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

title: Cronos: Lazarus
summary: Wield the Warden’s power in this combat‑heavy expansion to Cronos: The New Dawn, pushing the series toward faster, more aggressive action. Teleport, strike, and outrun a relentless hunter using enhanced traversal, decoys, and temporary invisibility as you race to revive a lost Essence before the Collective closes in.

title: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
summary: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.

title: Sombras: Negative Frames
summary: ‘Sombras: Negative Frames’ is a first person narrative game with a focus on photography and light horror elements. Follow Shiomi, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, as she is spirited away in a dark mirror of her 2000s Japanese town and must confront fragments of her own psyche.

title: The Cup: Creature Card Battler
summary:
The Cup is a free-to-play 1v1 creature card battler, broadcast live. You coach a survivor and a line of three creatures: real North American animals, plus a few cryptids. Every turn you play one card and make one attack, then a die decides how hard it lands while two announcers call it from the booth.

The Road is a roguelite run of cases against invasive species. Draft creatures and kits as you go, take your spoils after each win, and a knocked-out creature is gone for the rest of the run. The stars you win pay ratings that unlock more creatures in the Compendium. Between runs, play the House as often as you like, or go live 1v1 against other players.

title: Dumpster Gang
summary: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

title: Quadrillion Carrots
summary: Harvest an absurd number of carrots! Start with your bare hands, unlock powerful tools and helper robots, explore six farming zones, catch living carrots, survive explosive ones, and turn manual labor into harvesting chaos.

title: PowerWash Simulator 2: Barbie Pack
summary: With Barbie, You Can Be Anything! Turns out, “anything” includes a PowerWasher Barbie. Step outside of the box and power wash your way through Malibu in this clean-up adventure spanning five levels. Spray away muck, revealing sparkling, pristine plastic beneath!

title: Click Bait
summary: Click Bait is a rhythm roguelite where the worst monsters of the internet finally face justice, requiring you to master the art of timing your clicks around a continuous spinning wheel to defeat these online threats.

title: Defenders of Cinderkeep
summary: Defenders of Cinderkeep is a dark fantasy incremental auto-battler. Battle endless waves of orcs, demons, dragons, and other mythic creatures in defense of the last bastion of humanity. Upgrade your heroes and equip them with a variety of spells and powers to unleash upon the demonic hordes.

title: Chief? About That File...

Aery – Four Seasons is a relaxing, story-driven flight exploration game that carries you through a living world as it turns slowly from one season into the next. You play as a tiny bird-shaped spirit, drifting endlessly forward as the land beneath you blossoms, ripens, fades, and freezes — a full year unfolding one wingbeat at a time.

Begin in the first breath of spring, gliding over orchards heavy with pink and white blossom as meltwater trickles down from the last patches of snow and everything reaches greedily for the light. Drift into the long golden afternoons of summer, where wildflower meadows ripple in the warm air, still lakes mirror the sky, and fireflies begin to glow as the day softens toward dusk. Soar through the amber and crimson forests of autumn, leaves spiraling loose around you and mist gathering in the valleys as great flocks gather to move on. And finally, settle into the deep hush of winter — frozen lakes, bare silver trees, and a night sky rippling with quiet color over the snow.

Each season is its own self-contained world: a unique color palette, atmosphere, and mood that tells a different piece of a larger, quietly unfolding story. Hidden across every landscape are glowing memory fragments — scattered clues to the life this world holds through its endless turning. Collect enough of them and the season shifts, carrying you gently into the next.

Aery – Four Seasons is designed above all else to feel good. The flying is smooth and freeing, the world is warm and beautiful, and the story unfolds gently without ever demanding anything of you. Whether you play to explore, to collect, or simply to get lost somewhere peaceful, there is always something new waiting just beyond the changing horizon
